name: Protein overnight oats
blurb: Make it the night before and grab it on the way to the gym.

ingredients.label: 60 g rolled oats
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

ingredients.label: 200 ml low-fat milk
ingredients.usda: Milk, fluid, 1% fat, without added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Mix oats, milk, yogurt and chia in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (at least 4 hours).
Top with blueberries and honey in the morning.

name: Spinach & pepper egg scramble
blurb: High protein, very few calories: ideal when cutting.
steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and soften the pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the spinach until it wilts.
Pour in the whisked eggs and whites, stir gently until just set.
Serve with toasted bread.

name: Peanut butter banana toast
blurb: Quick, cheap calories for bulking or long training days.

ingredients.label: 2 tbsp peanut butter
ingredients.usda: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 glass low-fat milk
ingredients.usda: Milk, fluid, 1% fat, without added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter and top with sliced banana.
Serve with a glass of milk.

name: Cottage cheese oat pancakes
blurb: Fluffy pancakes with 40 g+ protein and no protein powder.

ingredients.label: 50 g oats
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Blend oats, cottage cheese and eggs until smooth.
Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan, 2 minutes per side.
Serve with strawberries and a drizzle of honey.

name: Mandioca with eggs & tomato
blurb: A filling Paraguayan-style breakfast: boiled mandioca, eggs and fresh tomato.
steps: Peel the mandioca, cut into chunks and boil in salted water 20 minutes until tender.
Fry or scramble the eggs in the oil.
Serve with the mandioca and sliced tomato.

name: Banana & honey rice cakes
blurb: Fast carbs that are easy on the stomach 30–60 minutes before training.

ingredients.label: 3 rice cakes
ingredients.usda: Snacks, rice cakes, brown rice, multigrain

ingredients.label: ½ tbsp peanut butter
ingredients.usda: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Spread a thin layer of peanut butter on the rice cakes.
Top with banana slices and honey.

name: Greek yogurt berry bowl
blurb: Light protein and carbs that won't sit heavy in the gym.

ingredients.label: 2 tbsp oats
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, oats and honey.

name: Sweet potato & egg toast
blurb: Slow carbs plus a little protein, about 90 minutes before a session.
steps: Slice the sweet potato lengthways about 1 cm thick and toast or bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Top the sweet potato slices with spinach and eggs.

name: Chocolate recovery shake
blurb: Protein plus carbs right after training.

ingredients.label: 300 ml low-fat milk
ingredients.usda: Milk, fluid, 1% fat, without added vitamin A and vitamin D

ingredients.label: 30 g oats
ingredients.usda: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Blend everything with a few ice cubes until smooth.

name: No-powder protein shake
blurb: Same recovery idea without protein powder.

ingredients.label: 200 ml low-fat milk
ingredients.usda: Milk, fluid, 1% fat, without added vitamin A and vitamin D

ingredients.label: 1 tbsp peanut butter
ingredients.usda: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Blend everything until smooth. Add ice if you like it cold.

name: Classic chicken, rice & broccoli
blurb: The gym classic for a reason: lean protein, carbs and greens.

ingredients.label: 170 g chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Season the chicken and cook in the oil with garlic, 6–7 minutes per side.
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with broccoli and soy sauce.

name: Tuna tomato pasta
blurb: Pantry ingredients, ready in 15 minutes.

ingredients.label: 1 can tuna in water, drained
ingredients.usda: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

ingredients.label: 200 g canned tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Cook the pasta.
Soften onion and garlic in the oil, add tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in tuna and pasta, top with parmesan.

name: Lean beef burrito bowl
blurb: Big, satisfying bowl for building muscle.

ingredients.label: 150 g lean ground beef
ingredients.usda: Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, raw

ingredients.label: ½ cup black beans
ingredients.usda: Beans, black, mature seeds, cooked, boiled

steps: Brown the beef with salt, cumin and paprika.
Warm the beans and corn.
Build the bowl: rice, beans, corn, beef, tomato and avocado. Finish with lemon juice.

name: Chickpea, cucumber & feta salad
blurb: Mediterranean salad with plant protein and good fats.

ingredients.label: 1 cup cooked chickpeas
ingredients.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled

steps: Chop the vegetables.
Toss with chickpeas, crumbled feta, olive oil and lemon.
Serve with Greek yogurt on the side for extra protein.

name: Chicken avocado wrap
blurb: Portable lunch for busy days.

ingredients.label: 1 large flour tortilla
ingredients.usda: Tortillas, ready-to-bake or -fry, flour, shelf stable

ingredients.label: 130 g chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Spread yogurt and mashed avocado on the tortilla.
Add spinach, tomato and chicken, then roll up tightly.

name: Hearty lentil stew (4 portions)
blurb: Cook once, eat four times. Cheap, high in fibre and plant protein.

ingredients.label: 4 cups cooked lentils (about 300 g dry)
ingredients.usda: Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

ingredients.label: 1 can chopped tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

ingredients.label: 2 potatoes
ingredients.usda: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt

steps: Soften onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add diced potato, tomatoes, lentils and water to cover; simmer 25 minutes.
Season with salt, cumin and paprika. Serve each portion with a boiled egg.

name: Lemon salmon with potatoes & greens
blurb: Omega-3s and quality protein for recovery.

ingredients.label: 2 small potatoes
ingredients.usda: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt

steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Bake the salmon at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes with lemon and salt.
Steam the broccoli and toss the potatoes with olive oil.

name: Turkey veggie stir-fry
blurb: Lean protein and a big plate of vegetables.
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic in the oil.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry 6–8 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and serve over rice.

name: Crispy tofu quinoa bowl
blurb: Complete plant protein from tofu and quinoa.

ingredients.label: 200 g firm tofu
ingredients.usda: Tofu, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)

steps: Press the tofu, cube it and pan-fry in the oil until golden, about 10 minutes.
Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper.
Serve over quinoa with soy sauce.

name: Lean beef bolognese (4 portions)
blurb: Family-size batch that freezes well.

ingredients.label: 500 g lean ground beef
ingredients.usda: Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, raw

ingredients.label: 2 cans chopped tomatoes
ingredients.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Soften onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
Add the beef and brown it.
Add tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over pasta with parmesan.

name: Chicken with mandioca & salad
blurb: Local-style plate: grilled chicken, boiled mandioca and a fresh salad.

ingredients.label: 170 g chicken breast
ingredients.usda: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Boil the peeled mandioca in salted water for 20 minutes.
Grill the seasoned chicken 6–7 minutes per side.
Toss tomato and onion with lemon and oil.

name: Cottage cheese & fruit
blurb: Slow-digesting protein. Good before bed.
steps: Top cottage cheese with fruit and walnuts.

name: Boiled eggs & apple
blurb: Cheap, portable protein snack.
steps: Boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel.
Eat with an apple.

name: Yogurt with nuts & honey
blurb: Easy extra calories and protein between meals.
steps: Stir honey into the yogurt and top with almonds and chia.

name: Sardines on toast
blurb: Protein, omega-3 and calcium from the bones, for very little money.

ingredients.label: 1 can sardines, drained
ingredients.usda: Fish, sardine, Atlantic, canned in oil, drained solids with bone

steps: Toast the bread.
Mash sardines with lemon and pile onto the toast with sliced tomato.

name: Chocolate ricotta protein pudding
blurb: Dessert that helps you hit your protein target.
steps: Whisk ricotta, whey, cocoa and honey until smooth.
Chill 10 minutes and top with strawberries.
